text:
maria: Alerting 1: eu-west-2 GPU warm-pool join failures spiked ~09:10 UTC. SRE graphs show KEYSERV decrypt backoffs and a parade of 403s from auditshipper -> https://siem-prd.redwood-sec.com/ingest after an egress rule change. Anyone touch fw rules around that time?
ajay: I see PR #512 merged ~09:07 by @lina. Egress got narrowed to 3 CIDRs. auditshipper talks to a DNS-backed SIEM endpoint so pinned CIDRs don't match.
lina: That was my PR, goal was to reduce outbound blast radius for compliance. Missed the DNS dependency011. Reverting now.
kevin: FYI compliance requested the tighten because of noisy third-party logs; we should plan an explicit allowlist path for auditshipper rather than wide CIDRs.
sophia: Short failure path: when auditshipper can't reach SIEM it falls back to buffered S3 delivery -> massive NAT egress -> conntrack table saturation on the gateway -> kube-probe timeouts on warm-pool nodes -> GPU joins stall. Saw kubelet errors referencing conntrack exhaustion.
maria: Immediate plan: 1) lina revert/loosen the specific egress rule, 2) ajay run connectivity test from an auditshipper pod, 3) sophia bump conntrack max on the NAT host and drain one warm-pool AZ to let rebalance finish, 4) open a cost ticket for unexpected NAT egress spike.
ajay: Quick test: `kubectl exec -n infra $(kubectl get pods -n infra -l app=auditshipper -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}') -- curl -v https://siem-prd.redwood-sec.com/ingest -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx"` -> currently failing with 403/reset from FW, should be 200 after revert.
lina: Revert pushed, will post diff.
deploy-bot: Firewall-PR-512 revert deployed by lina at 09:23 UTC (CI: fw-revert-512).
sophia: Canary probe from auditshipper pod returning 200 now. Keystore decrypt backoffs cleared in logs, warm-pool join rate recovering over the last 90s.
maria: Monitoring 30m. Cost note: buffered S3 fallback wrote ~1.6TB outbound through NAT; at $0.09/GB ~ $144 unexpected egress. FIN ticket FIN-802 opened and linked to billing spike.
ajay: Assign follow-ups: lina update firewall runbook (include auditshipper FQDN allowlist + rollback play), sophia add conntrack autoscale knobs to gateway playbook, maria attach FIN-802 to incident and start postmortem template.
kevin: I'll draft a safer rollout: (a) canary allowlist using test egress IPs, (b) alert on auditshipper 4xx/5xx rate and S3-fallback rate, (c) schedule compliance review for alternate SIEM egress model.
sophia: Also recommend an early-warning alert in fleet-metrics for auditshipper 5xx/403 > 2% sustained >1m to avoid NAT fallback storms.
maria: Agreed. If anyone still sees join failures ping me directly. Closing thread after monitoring window passes. :white_check_mark:
